limitations_and_unresolved_assumptions: Pre-7C deployment periods are UNKNOWN; no production release was invented to bridge them.

Earlier 7B field wording, eight ownership responsibilities, four retired interactions, eight prior contract optional-field shapes, and twelve prior dependency versions are explicitly synthetic retrospective reconstructions, not independently confirmed production logs.

Config values are fictional non-secret Stage 7E manifest observations attributed to actual release windows; 7C did not itself include configuration manifests. Old config values are estimates when flagged.
Historical component versions lack an independent earlier lockfile, so historical artifacts are not evidence that those exact packages were deployed.
Eleven flow records identify documented relationships, not captured traffic payloads or a precomputed impact graph.
The manifest's own actual SHA-256 is carried in the ZIP comment and final delivery rather than recursively embedded within itself.
